OFFICIAL TRANSPARENCY REPORT: TEAM KRYSTON
(November 17, 2025 – February 28, 2026)

Integrity and accountability are the cornerstones of our community. We are officially releasing our financial summary to ensure that every contribution from our supporters is fully accounted for.

Financial Summary
Total Collected Funds: ₱299,133.90
Total Project Expenses: ₱296,777.90
Remaining Balance: ₱2,356.00
(Note: For a detailed breakdown of all project costs, voting allocations, and cash inflows, please refer to the attached official documentation.)

We would like to extend our deepest gratitude to our Sponsors. Your generous support—most notably for the EDSA Billboard—provided the vital infrastructure needed to elevate our campaign to a professional scale.

To our dedicated Stunners, thank you for the unwavering trust you have placed in this team. From the various "Ipon" Challenges to the Matching Challenges, your financial discipline and passion have been the driving force behind every milestone reached.
We remain committed to maintaining this level of transparency as we move forward into our future projects.

Team Kryston Official
Direct. Transparent. Solid.

#KrystalMejes | #AntonVinzon | #KRYSTON
